scripts.test: npm run test:functions && npm run test:build && npm run test:rules && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:rules: npm run test:rules:governance && npm run test:rules:maintenance
scripts.test:rules:governance: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-kanata-governance "vitest run tests/rules/governance.rules.test.js"
scripts.test:rules:maintenance: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-kanata-maintenance "vitest run tests/rules/maintenance.rules.test.js"
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && X_OEMBED_EMULATOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9394/oembed firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore,storage --project demo-kanata-governance "vitest run tests/integration"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:hosting && X_OEMBED_EMULATOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9394/oembed firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore,storage,hosting --project demo-kanata-governance "playwright test"
